mandatory_retrieval_dependency: The discovered module IDs determine the complete module GET arguments. The root enzyme and direct link request can be made independently; discovered modules can be retrieved in one batch.
optional_alternative: Generic reaction MODULE fields also exposed the observed modules in the earlier probe. That executed path is not a mandatory extra layer because direct enzyme-to-module links suffice.
shortest_path_note: Direct links followed by a batch GET of the root enzyme and discovered modules is a two-request possibility under the supplied API limit. Its specific combined URL was not separately downloaded; the supplied evidence uses separate root and module responses.
limits: Grouping is computation, not another retrieval dependency. Supplying the full discovered evidence package to a solver would remove the retrieval dependency. Neither catalogs nor an unknown dump are asserted to establish difficulty.
